clips.title: The story
paras: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Marryk Nurribit teaches young gnomes the arcane arts. He favors local brews over strict lessons and often asks his pupils for spare coins to buy a drink.

Marryk Nurribit teaches young gnomes magic inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He knows the arcane arts, though he takes a casual approach to teaching. A flagon of dwarven ale often holds more of his attention than a lesson, and he asks his new pupils for spare pocket change. He also warns aspiring spellcasters about the dangers beyond Coldridge Valley, where Gnomeregan's ruins remain radioactive and infested with troggs.
